card.name: Words of reduction before function loss
card.fires_on: Words meaning reduction or lowering (in, decreased, depressed, lower, diminished) placed just before a function or ability such as alertness, consciousness, respiratory drive or reflexes. Seen in adverse-effect and interaction text.
